QuestInfo.name: A Game of Shadows
QuestInfo.1: #p3001006# wants you to get a #b#t4033395##k from the tree at the top of the #b#m401030100##k and eliminate #b100#k #r#o2400110##k monsters at the #b#m401030500##k or #b#m401040300##k.
QuestInfo.2: You helped out #p3001006#. Go check in with #b#p3001004##k.

0.0: And don't mind me...I'm not huge into this whole "merchant crew" thing. Boss #p3001004# and my bro #p3001005# always remind me not to say that, but eh.
0.1: You know how our merchant crew works, right? We're the hardest of the hardcore, traders to the end, anything for a Meso, perfect merchants! ...At least, my brothers are. They just drag me around because 3 is the magic number, or something.
0.2: Doesn't matter what we're trading... Household goods, rare finds, dangerous materials, information...even some seriously shady stuff. That's supposed to be a secret, but eh.
0.3: Yep, we do anything for that sweet, sweet cash. We even pop up in the most dangerous, bone-headed places to do business! That's probably why people call us the Shadowdealers. 'Cause we... deal in the shadows... and stuff. I guess.
0.4: We all have to wear this mask, to hide our identities and show the world that we're part of the crew. And now that I say that out loud, it seems really stupid.
0.5: Okay, enough for that. I actually have a personal request. Boss #p3001004# said that you'd do it.
0.6: Have you ever heard of the Morrow Tree? Because I want Morrow Tree Sap. It stays extra-cold, so it's good for summer drinks and machine coolant.
0.7: Please obtain one bottle of it, and eliminate #b100#k #r#o2400110##k monsters while you're at it. No real reason...I just don't like the way they look.\r\n#r#e(If you accept, you will automatically move to the relevant field.)\r\n

yes.1: Get the sap from the tree at the top of the hill over at #b#m401030100##k. #r#o2400110##k can be found over at #b#m401030500##k or #b#m401040300##k!
yes.0: Awesome. Remember, it's #b1 bottle#k of Morrow Tree Sap and #b100#k #rGuerrilla Specters#k downed!

no.0: Come on, Kaiser! Don't be like that!

yes.0: Hey, this is some quality sap! Thanks! Ah, right, #p3001004# was looking for you. Sigh...he told me we'd be working together for awhile, but he's calling you back already! What a gyp.

item.0: I don't think you got enough sap. Remember, it's #b1 bottle of #t4033395##k! You brought me...nothing!

mob.0: Make sure to eliminate 100 #r#o2400110##k monsters, too!
